alternative_notation.dimension_formula: osp(2m|2n) with m=1, even = 2n^2 + n + 1, odd = 4n, total = 2n^2 + 5n + 1

kappa.label: kappa
kappa.description: Odd central element parametrizing inhomogeneous deformations (kappa^2 = 0)

K.label: K
K.description: Even central identity element from oscillator canonical relations

fermions.description: Standard fermionic oscillator pair a_1^± satisfying CAR

basis.ordering_convention: PBW: kappa < [odd: E_eps1_del{k}_pp/pm/mp/mm] < [even: H_k, E_2del{k}_p/m, E_del{i}_del{j}_pp/mm/pm/mp]

generator_realization.description: Normal ordered form: fermions then bosons

f_map_parameters.description: Basis parameters for odd linear maps f: g -> g (reversing parity)

coboundary_operator.description: Symbolic coboundary coefficients (delta f)_{ab}^k(phi_{i,j}) where (delta f)(X,Y) = (-1)^{p(X)}[X, f(Y)] - (-1)^{(p(X)+1)p(Y)}[Y, f(X)] - f([X,Y])

references: Frappat et al. (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
